title: attestation: Add the base family specification and generated files
overview: Defines the base attestation CTLV family specification-first: the YAML spec, its ABI snapshot, registry entries, and the generated UAPI and kernel files. The spec drives all generated outputs; the generated descriptor references handlers and hooks that later patches (provider, journal, ops) provide, so it is not linked until then.

files.purpose: Checked-in ABI snapshot of the attestation family, regenerated by `make -C tools/ctlv abi-update`; the checker diffs the live spec against it so any UAPI change is a visible, reviewable edit.

units.title: Header and family declaration
units.summary: Snapshot preamble and the family line: name, ID 1, inherits ctlv, post-init and pre-fini hooks.
units.details: The ID 1 is the family's position in the central registry. The checker compares the live spec against this file, so changes to it are the reviewed record of UAPI changes.

units.title: Enums and flags snapshot
units.summary: Numeric values frozen for the three enums and two flag sets.
units.details: Enum values are explicit numbers (raw=1, primary=1, info=1/extend=2); flags are bit positions (read=0, extend=1).

units.title: Attribute groups snapshot
units.summary: Frozen group IDs and attribute IDs, types and bounds for device, cap, evidence, mr, log and notification.
units.details: Each attribute carries its explicit ID, so renumbering or removal shows up as an ABI break. Spec-level details like blob direction and backings are condensed (e.g. `data: {blob: output, backings: [va]}`).

units.title: Attribute sets snapshot
units.summary: IDs of the 23 attr-sets; only device-info is marked as a stub.
units.details: The stub set is the extension point later filled by a provider-specific family (e.g. TDX) through the inheritance mechanism.

units.title: Op device-get
units.summary: Fixed action returning device capabilities and the info stub, with the reply's nested tree spelled out.
units.details: The reply tree expands device.caps into optional cap.evidence (with objects) and cap.mr, plus device.info bound to the device-info stub set.

units.title: Op evidence-get
units.summary: Dynamic, optional action: challenge plus object descriptors in, per-object lengths and optional MR generation out.
units.details: availability is dynamic, so a provider can enable and disable it at runtime.

units.title: Ops mr-get, mr-dump, mr-read
units.summary: Measurement-register introspection ops: get properties of one register, dump all, read the current values.
units.details: All are optional and fd-access read; dump and read are queries (multi-message replies).

units.title: Op mr-extend
units.summary: Optional action to extend a register with a hash value, returning the new generation.

units.title: Ops mr-log-entry-appended and mr-log-get
units.summary: The event announcing a log entry and the query that retrieves log entries by selection and generation range.
units.details: Event ID 7 is not optional and has no fd-access; both share the same entry shape (generation, mr id, event, optional value and register info).

files.purpose: Central ordered list of families whose position defines their family ID.

units.title: Register ctlv-attestation
units.summary: Appends ctlv-attestation after ctlv, reserving family ID 1.

units.title: List ctlv-attestation
units.summary: Adds the family to the tooling's list of families.

files.purpose: Maps each family to its spec and generated output paths for the regen and verify scripts.

units.title: ctlv-attestation outputs
units.summary: Declares the spec source and the three outputs: UAPI header, kernel header and kernel source under drivers/attestation/generated.

files.purpose: The authoritative YAML specification of the attestation family (enums, flags, attribute groups, attribute sets, ops). All generated files and the ABI snapshot derive from it.

units.title: Header and family
units.summary: Source spec header and family declaration (inherits ctlv, enables post-init and pre-fini).
units.details: This is the input from which the three generated files are produced by tools/ctlv/ctlv-regen.sh.

units.title: Enums and flags
units.summary: Value names for evidence-representation, evidence-blob-class and mr-log-event, and the read/extend flag sets for devices and registers.
units.details: IDs are assigned by position by the generator; the ABI snapshot freezes them.

units.title: Attr groups: device and cap
units.summary: Device-level attributes and the capability attributes describing evidence and measurement-register support.
units.details: Attributes referencing `attrs:` nest another attr-set; `device.info` points at the stub set device-info. Object entries are capped at 16 occurrences.

units.title: Attr group: evidence
units.summary: Request/reply attributes for evidence-get: challenge, object descriptors, output blob and per-object lengths.
units.details: `data` is an output blob that may only be backed by a virtual address (`va`), up to U32_MAX bytes.

units.title: Attr group: mr
units.summary: Measurement-register attributes: ids, names, hash algorithms, capabilities, values and log generation range.
units.details: Hash-algo is bounded to 20 and value data is 16..64 bytes; `item` is an unlimited repeated nest used by mr-dump.

units.title: Attr groups: log and notification
units.summary: Log entry, event type and register-info attributes, plus the notification wrapper for the event op.

units.title: Attr sets: capabilities and device
units.summary: Sets describing the device-get reply tree, evidence requests/replies and mr properties.
units.details: Sets name which group attributes are required (`attrs`) and which are optional (`optional-attrs`); ops refer to sets by name.

units.title: Attr sets: mr request/reply
units.summary: Sets for the mr-* ops requests and replies.

units.title: Attr sets: log
units.summary: Sets for log entries, the appended-event payload, selection and the log-get request/reply.

units.title: Ops: device, evidence and mr getters
units.summary: Declarations of device-get, evidence-get, mr-get and mr-dump with type, fd-access, optionality and trees.
units.details: Only device-get is mandatory; the rest are `optional: true` so providers publish them on demand. suggested-reply-length sizes query messages.

units.title: Ops: mr-read, mr-extend, log
units.summary: Remaining ops: mr-read, mr-extend, the mr-log-entry-appended event and mr-log-get.
units.details: mr-extend is the only op besides evidence-get with read-write fd access.

files.purpose: Maintainer entry for the new subsystem.

units.title: ATTESTATION SUBSYSTEM entry
units.summary: Adds maintainer, list and file patterns covering the spec, ABI snapshot, drivers/attestation and UAPI headers.

files.purpose: Generated kernel source for the family: flattened node-schema trees per op request/reply, the op schema table, family schema, op bindings and the exported family descriptor. Generated from the spec by tools/ctlv/ctlv-regen.sh; sections are described, not every table row.

units.title: Header and includes
units.summary: Generated-file banner and includes; metadata-only mode is selected before including ctlv_family.h.
units.details: `_CTLV_GENERATED_METADATA_ONLY` hides the accessor helpers in the kernel header so this file only sees schema and family declarations.

units.title: Schema trees: device-get
units.summary: Node-schema tables for the device-get request (empty) and reply, plus the stub table.
units.details: Each tree is a flattened array: a ROOT node followed by nested nodes with indexes to their children and counts of children/required children. Attribute bounds (occurrences, min/max) mirror the spec. The stub entry marks where the device-info set may be filled by a descendant family.

units.title: Schema trees: evidence-get and mr-get
units.summary: Request/reply trees for evidence-get and mr-get.
units.details: The evidence data attribute is a BLOB limited to `BIT(CTLV_BLOB_TYPE_VA)` with output direction.

units.title: Schema trees: mr-dump, mr-read, mr-extend
units.summary: Trees for mr-dump, mr-read and mr-extend requests and replies.

units.title: Schema trees: log event and mr-log-get
units.summary: Trees for the appended-log event and the log-get query.

units.title: Op schema table
units.summary: Per-op schema entries built with CTLV_OP_SCHEMA_ACTION/QUERY/EVENT in declaration order.
units.details: Each carries fd-access, availability, computed max request/reply sizes, the trees, and `.optional`. Queries add the suggested reply length; the event carries only a queue length (3368).

units.title: Family schema and generated guards
units.summary: Family schema (name, ID 1, ops) and static_asserts that generated maxima fit core limits.
units.details: The asserts bound uevent length/vars, inline message length, event queue length and nest depth against core constants.

units.title: Op bindings
units.summary: Handler table for the family's actions and queries.
units.details: References ctlv_attestation_<op> symbols that later patches define; the event has no handler.

units.title: Family descriptor
units.summary: The exported `ctlv_attestation_family`, with parent `ctlv_family` and the hooks used by ctlv_create().
units.details: The hooks (pre/post, priv_size, init, post_init, pre_fini, fini) are implemented by later patches; this is why the descriptor is only linked then.

files.purpose: Generated kernel header: schema externs, handler and hook prototypes, and typed accessor/builder macros for requests, replies and events. Included by the family implementation and (via metadata-only mode) by the generated source.

units.title: Header and includes
units.summary: Generated banner, include guard and includes.

units.title: Schema externs and op handler prototypes
units.summary: Declares the schema tables and one handler prototype per action/query.
units.details: Handlers receive the family priv, op ctx, validated request cursor and reply cursor.

units.title: Family hooks and descriptor
units.summary: Prototypes for the pre/post op hooks and the priv lifecycle, plus the family descriptor extern.
units.details: These are the symbols the later provider/ops patches must supply.

units.title: Optional-op helpers
units.summary: CTLV_OP_PROVIDE/ENABLE/DISABLE inline helpers for optional and dynamic ops.
units.details: Only evidence-get gets ENABLE/DISABLE because it is the only dynamic op.

units.title: Request accessors: evidence
units.summary: Generated CTLV_IN_* readers for the evidence-get request.
units.details: The reference macros bind an op's request tree to a node index; blob attributes have a resolver instead of a getter.

units.title: Request accessors: mr ops
units.summary: Readers for mr-get, mr-read, mr-extend and mr-log-get requests.

units.title: Reply writers
units.summary: One CTLV_PUT_*/CTLV_NEST_START helper per attribute, for building replies and events.
units.details: Appends are atomic; nests close with ctlv_nest_end().

units.title: Event builder
units.summary: CTLV_EVENT_CREATE for mr-log-entry-appended and the end of the header guard.

files.purpose: Generated UAPI header with the family's enums, flag masks, group/attribute IDs, attr-set IDs and op IDs; userspace includes it to cover the whole effective (inherited) schema.

units.title: Header and includes
units.summary: Banner, guard and includes (including the inherited ctlv headers).

units.title: Enums and flag sets
units.summary: C enums for spec enums, and bit enums plus bitmask macros for the two flag sets.

units.title: Groups and ATTR macro
units.summary: Group IDs and the `_CTLV_ATTESTATION_ATTR` macro combining family, group and attribute.
units.details: Attribute values are composed with CTLV_ATTR(family, group, attr).

units.title: Attrs of group device
units.summary: Device attribute enum and public macros.

units.title: Attrs of group cap
units.summary: Capability attribute enum and macros.

units.title: Attrs of group evidence
units.summary: Evidence attribute enum and macros.

units.title: Attrs of group mr
units.summary: Measurement-register attribute enum and macros.

units.title: Attrs of groups log and notification
units.summary: Log and notification attribute enums and macros.

units.title: Attr set IDs
units.summary: Enum of attr-set IDs, used e.g. by the stub schema (DEVICE_INFO).

units.title: Op IDs
units.summary: Op enum and `CTLV_ATTESTATION_OP_*` macros wrapping CTLV_OP(family, op), then the guard end.

files.purpose: Generated enum of family IDs, extended from the registry.

units.title: Add CTLV_FAMILY_ATTESTATION
units.summary: Adds the attestation family ID right after the root family.
units.details: Value 1, matching `family_id = 1` in the generated source.
